_metadata.source: Jeppesen Airway Manual (Enroute, Communications, ADS-B, CPDLC & SSR Sections)

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 to 25 minutes prior to entering SBCW FIR (or before departure when departing from SBJH/SBGR/SBKP/SBSP)
cpdlc.notes: Compulsory initial voice contact on sector VHF frequency before CPDLC data link transfer. Downlink initial CPDLC position report upon connection.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: 1090ES ADS-B Out and Mode S required in RVSM airspace (FL290-FL410).

slop.offsetRule: Centerline or 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM RIGHT of centerline in oceanic/remote sectors

brazilContingencyPlan.summary: In ATS contingency within Brazilian FIRs, prior takeoff authorization from CGNA is mandatory. Monitor 123.45 MHz (TIBA) & 121.5 MHz, broadcast 10 min prior to FIR entry and 5 min prior to waypoints, keep exterior lights ON, never climb/descend through occupied FLs.

ssr.transponderFailureRule: After departure: ATC units endeavor to allow continuation to first planned landing aerodrome where repair must be performed. Before departure: Inform ATC prior to filing FPL, insert 'N' in Item 10b, fly most direct route to repair station.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 to 25 minutes prior to entering SBBS FIR
cpdlc.notes: FANS 1/A CPDLC operational in upper airspace. Primary VHF voice retained in continental radar sectors.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: ADS-B Out 1090ES required FL290+.

slop.offsetRule: Up to 2.0 NM right of track in 0.1 NM increments

brazilContingencyPlan.summary: Brazilian FIR National & International Contingency Plan applies: TIBA on 123.45 MHz, CGNA slot/entry coordination required.

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Standard ICAO & DECEA procedures: continue to first planned landing aerodrome for mandatory transponder restoration.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 to 25 minutes prior to entering Amazonica FIR
cpdlc.notes: FANS 1/A CPDLC & ADS-C active across remote Amazonia sectors; HF backup required.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: ADS-B Out and FANS 1/A ADS-C used for surveillance in remote Amazon sectors.

slop.offsetRule: 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM right of centerline recommended in remote continental segments

brazilContingencyPlan.summary: DECEA Contingency Plan: TIBA 123.45 MHz broadcasts 10 min prior to FIR entry and 5 min prior to reporting points.

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Inform ACC immediately; repair required at next landing.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 to 25 minutes prior to SBAO FIR boundary
cpdlc.notes: Compulsory FANS 1/A CPDLC & ADS-C in EUR/SAM corridor. Downlink initial position report upon logon.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: Space-based ADS-B & ADS-C surveillance active in EUR/SAM Corridor.
pbnAdsB.lateralSeparation: 30 NM (RNP 4) / 50 NM (RNP 10) Lateral Separation in EUR/SAM Oceanic

slop.offsetRule: Mandatory SLOP eligibility: centerline or 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM RIGHT of track without ATC clearance

brazilContingencyPlan.summary: South Atlantic Contingency routes and TIBA 123.45 MHz procedures apply.

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Maintain Mode A/C 2000 in oceanic airspace for TCAS collision avoidance.

cpdlc.logonTiming: Establish VHF voice contact with Asuncion ACC 10 mins prior to FIR boundary (FOZ / GUAIRA transition)
cpdlc.notes: No CPDLC in SGFA FIR. Monitor Asuncion ACC on VHF and verify SGES (Ciudad del Este) VES VOR/DME outage impacts.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: SSR Mode A/C/S surveillance; RNAV 5 on upper routes (UL/UM/UN).

slop.offsetRule: Standard procedural separation; SLOP up to 2.0 NM right when outside radar coverage

customAlerts: AIC A004/24 (Paraguay): Minimum meteorological visibility required for takeoff at all Paraguayan airports is 400m.
AIP SUP (Paraguay): VES VOR/DME (114.1 MHz) at SGES (Guaraní Intl) unserviceable — VOR/DME approaches suspended.

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Standard ICAO procedure: Squawk 2000 if unassigned. Inform Asuncion ACC prior to entry if transponder unserviceable.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 15 to 45 minutes prior to entering Ezeiza Oceanic sector
cpdlc.notes: FANS 1/A CPDLC/ADS-C in Oceanic sector; VHF voice in continental sectors.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: Mode S / SSR required in controlled airspace.

slop.offsetRule: 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM right of track in oceanic airspace

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Standard ICAO transponder failure rules apply. Obtain ATC clearance before entering TMA.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 15 to 45 minutes prior to entering Cayenne FIR
cpdlc.notes: From Jeppesen SAM Enroute p.143: Logon to SOOO between 15 and 45 minutes prior to entry.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: ADS-B / ADS-C active above FL245.

slop.offsetRule: 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM right of centerline

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Standard ICAO procedures; notify Rochambeau ACC immediately.

KZWY.name: New York Oceanic FIR / WAT CTA (USA)

cpdlc.logonTiming: 15 to 45 minutes prior to entering New York Oceanic FIR / WAT CTA
cpdlc.notes: PBCS (RCP240/RSP180) required for reduced separation tracks. HF backup via New York ARINC required.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: 1090ES ADS-B Out mandatory in US Class A/B/C and WAT/NAT surveillance corridors (14 CFR 91.225).
pbnAdsB.rnpRequired: RNP 10 (PBN/A1) or RNP 4 (PBN/L1) required for 50 NM / 23 NM lateral separation in WAT/GoMex CTAs
pbnAdsB.lateralSeparation: 50 NM (RNP 10) / 23 NM (RNP 4 + PBCS) in West Atlantic (WAT) & Gulf of Mexico CTAs. Non-RNP10 must file RMK/NON-RNP10 and state 'Negative RNP 10'.

slop.offsetRule: Mandatory SLOP in NAT/WAT Oceanic: Centerline or 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM RIGHT of track without ATC clearance

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Squawk 2000 in NAT Oceanic after 30 mins unless assigned discrete code. Domestic US VFR squawk 1200.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 15 to 45 minutes prior to entering Gander Oceanic OCA
cpdlc.notes: Aircraft filing B1/B2 ADS-B in Item 10b are considered identified above FL285 in Gander OCA. CPDLC Uplink Latency Monitor active.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: Space-based ADS-B Out 1090ES mandatory across Canadian Class A/B and Gander OCA.
pbnAdsB.rnpRequired: RNP 4 (PBN/L1) or RNP 10 (PBN/A1) — NAT HLA & PBCS Tracks

slop.offsetRule: NAT HLA SLOP: Centerline or micro-offsets in 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM RIGHT of track

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Squawk 2000 30 mins after oceanic entry (except retain discrete code on polar/continental radar corridors).

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 to 25 minutes prior to Shanwick Oceanic boundary (Oceanic Clearance via RCL/VOICE 30-90 mins prior)
cpdlc.notes: NAT Oceanic Clearance Procedures (RCL via CPDLC/ACARS replaced legacy voice OCA where equipped). Uplink latency monitor mandatory.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: From Jeppesen Europe p.126: ADS-B equipage is mandatory on routes T9 and T290 within Shanwick Oceanic and above FL285.
pbnAdsB.rnpRequired: RNP 4 (PBN/L1) / RNP 10 (PBN/A1) — NAT HLA & PBCS Tracks

slop.offsetRule: NAT HLA SLOP: 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM RIGHT of track (0 NM or 0.1-2.0 NM right)

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Squawk 2000 in Shanwick OCA; set 7000 in European uncontrolled airspace unless assigned.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 15 to 45 minutes prior to entering BIRD FIR
cpdlc.notes: FANS 1/A CPDLC and ADS-C operational throughout Reykjavik OCA.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: From Jeppesen Europe p.127: Iceland has mandated ADS-B (1090ES) and Mode S for all aircraft in BIRD FIR and the Greenland Corridor (65N-69N / GUNPA-EMBOK at FL290+).

slop.offsetRule: 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM right of centerline

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Mode S and 1090ES ADS-B mandatory; exemption from Iceland ATS required prior to entry if unserviceable.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 15 minutes prior to FIR entry
cpdlc.notes: ATN B1 above FL285 in continental Polaris FIR; FANS 1/A in Bodo Oceanic (ENOB).

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: From Jeppesen Europe p.127-128: Transponder with 1090ES ADS-B extended squitter mandatory in the Bodo Corridor (6645N 000E to 81N 030E).

slop.offsetRule: 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM right in Bodo Oceanic airspace

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Standard European SSR rules; Squawk 7000 VFR.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 to 15 minutes prior to entering London UIR above FL285
cpdlc.notes: European Single Sky Data Link Mandate (DLM) via ATN B1 / VDL Mode 2 above FL285.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: 1090ES ADS-B Out & Mode S Enhanced Surveillance (EHS) mandatory.

slop.offsetRule: SLOP not authorized in domestic European radar airspace unless instructed by ATC

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Mode S EHS required; notify London Control immediately if transponder degrades.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 to 15 minutes prior to entering France UIR
cpdlc.notes: ATN B1 CPDLC operational across French UIRs (LFFF/LFEE/LFMM/LFBB/LFRR).

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: EU ADS-B Out 1090ES & Mode S EHS mandate applies.

slop.offsetRule: No SLOP in domestic European radar airspace

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Squawk 7000 VFR; prior authorization required if departing without serviceable Mode S transponder.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 minutes prior to entering Swiss FIR
cpdlc.notes: Skyguide ATN B1 CPDLC active; initial voice check-in mandatory on sector transfer.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: Mode S EHS & ADS-B Out required.

slop.offsetRule: No SLOP in Swiss radar airspace

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Squawk 7000 VFR below FL100 (or 7000 throughout Europe uncontrolled).

cpdlc.logonTiming: 5 to 10 minutes prior to entry into Nicosia FIR
cpdlc.notes: From Jeppesen Middle East p.68: CPDLC mandatory above FL285 via ATN B1 (Logon LCCC 5-10 mins prior).

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: ADS-B Out & Mode S required above FL285.

slop.offsetRule: Maintain assigned centerline; strict level/track adherence due to uncoordinated Ankara/Ercan boundary

nicosiaRelay.bulletinRef: Jeppesen Briefing Bulletin JEP 06 / IATA Operational Notice 004/21 (General p.13-14)
nicosiaRelay.summary: No direct coordination exists between Ankara and Nicosia ACCs. Authority in LCCC FIR rests SOLELY with Nicosia ACC — accept ATC instructions & SSR codes ONLY from Nicosia ACC. Southbound from Ankara: contact Nicosia ACC >=10 mins prior to VESAR/TOMBI. Northbound to Ankara: relay flight info >=10 mins prior on 126.70 MHz (Ercan) for relay to Ankara. Eastbound to Damascus: contact 10 mins prior to NIKAS or relay via Latakia Radio at VESAR/ALSUS/BALMA.

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Accept SSR code allocations ONLY from Nicosia ACC within LCCC FIR.

DIII.name: Abidjan FIS / Dakar & Roberts Corridor (West Africa)

cpdlc.logonTiming: 20 to 45 minutes prior to entry into Abidjan FIS (DGAC/FCCC: 15 to 45 mins prior)
cpdlc.notes: From Jeppesen Africa p.79: Logon to DIII should be initiated between 20 and 45 minutes prior to entry into Abidjan FIS.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: From Jeppesen Africa p.62: Space-based ADS-B services implemented within Abidjan FIS, Dakar, Niamey, N'Djamena, and Brazzaville FIRs.

ifbp1269.summary: IATA In-Flight Broadcast Procedure (IFBP) in Africa (Jeppesen Africa p.74-77): Maintain continuous listening watch on 126.9 MHz starting 10 mins prior to entry. Broadcast in English: 10 mins prior to FIR entry, upon entry, 10 mins prior to crossing/joining ATS routes, every 20 mins, and before/after any FL change. Operate TCAS in TA/RA at max range and display exterior lights during level changes.

slop.offsetRule: SLOP promoted across AFI region: Centerline or 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM RIGHT of track

ssr.transponderFailureRule: From Jeppesen Africa p.64-70: In case of transponder failure on a flight entering Abidjan, Dakar, Niamey, Ouagadougou, Cotonou, Douala, or Brazzaville TMA/UTA, the crew MUST inform the respective ACC/Approach at least 15 minutes before entering the airspace.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 15 to 45 minutes prior to entry into Brazzaville FIR
cpdlc.notes: From Jeppesen Africa p.79: CPDLC is primary means of communication in Brazzaville FIR (excluding Douala, Libreville, and Sao Tome UTA).

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: Space-based ADS-B operational across Brazzaville FIR.

ifbp1269.summary: Mandatory AFI IATA IFBP zone (Brazzaville FIR): Broadcast on 126.9 MHz 10 mins prior to entry, upon entry, every 20 mins, and before/after any FL change.

slop.offsetRule: AFI SLOP: 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM RIGHT of centerline

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Mandatory 15-minute prior notification to Brazzaville ACC / Douala ACC before entering TMA/UTA with a failed transponder.

cpdlc.logonTiming: Contact Cairo ACC on assigned VHF frequency 10 mins prior to FIR boundary
cpdlc.notes: Verify extensive Egypt RNAV route changes (L81, L604, M872, T223) in Cycle 2610/2611.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: SSR Mode A/C/S surveillance.
pbnAdsB.rnpRequired: RNAV 5 between FL160-FL460 (Note: HECA 10 NM GPS jamming prohibits RNAV GNSS approaches at Cairo)

slop.offsetRule: Radar controlled airspace; do not offset without ATC clearance

ssr.transponderFailureRule: From Jeppesen Africa p.65: Squawk 7000 as an uncontrolled flight; standard ICAO transponder failure rules.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 minutes prior to entry into Mumbai FIR
cpdlc.notes: From Jeppesen Middle East p.68: Logon to VABF 10 mins prior to entry. Downlink initial CPDLC position report upon connection; HF backup via Mumbai Radio (3443/5601/6661/8879/10084 kHz).

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: From Jeppesen Middle East p.63: All aircraft flying on PBN routes (L, M, N, P, Q, T and A201/A474/G450/W-routes) at or above FL290 in Indian airspace MUST carry serviceable 1090MHz ES ADS-B Out. Non-ADS-B restricted below FL290.

slop.offsetRule: Arabian Sea Oceanic: Centerline or 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM RIGHT of track

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Standard ICAO SSR procedures; valid Air Defense Clearance (ADC) number mandatory before entry.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 minutes prior to entry into Delhi FIR
cpdlc.notes: From Jeppesen Middle East p.67: Logon to VIDF 10 mins prior to entry.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: 1090MHz ES ADS-B Out mandatory at or above FL290 on all Indian PBN routes (L, M, N, P, Q, T).

slop.offsetRule: Continental radar airspace; offset only on ATC instruction

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Standard ICAO SSR procedures; ADC number required 10 mins prior to FIR entry.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 minutes prior to entry into Chennai FIR
cpdlc.notes: From Jeppesen Middle East p.67: Logon to VOMF 10 mins prior to entry; downlink initial CPDLC position report.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: 1090ES ADS-B Out mandatory at or above FL290 on all PBN routes and Bay of Bengal oceanic routes.

slop.offsetRule: Bay of Bengal Oceanic: 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM right of centerline

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Standard ICAO SSR procedures; India ADC required.

cpdlc.logonTiming: Obtain ADC from Karachi FIC at least 15 minutes prior to entering Pakistan airspace/ADIZ
cpdlc.notes: Must report estimate for ADIZ entry point and cross within ±5 minutes.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: SSR Mode A/C/S surveillance.

slop.offsetRule: 1 NM or 2 NM right of centerline in oceanic sector south of Karachi

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Standard ICAO SSR procedures; never enter Pakistan ADIZ without valid ADC and discrete squawk.

cpdlc.logonId: N/A (VHF Voice + Air Defense Radar 127.8 / 135.1 MHz)
cpdlc.logonTiming: Contact Iran Air Defense Radar on 127.8 MHz or 135.1 MHz at least 40 NM prior to entering Tehran FIR
cpdlc.notes: From Jeppesen Middle East p.54: Must enter at FL150+ via published ATS routes within ±5 mins of estimate. Forbidden to cross Bushehr VORDME 'BUZ' at FL280 or below.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: SSR Mode A/C/S mandatory; domestic squawk 0000.
pbnAdsB.rnpRequired: RNAV 5 / Preferential Route System (Middle East p.69-70)

slop.offsetRule: Strictly prohibited to deviate from published ATS route centerline inside Iran ADIZ

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Prior permission required if unable to maintain Mode A/C transponder or FL150+ entry.

cpdlc.logonTiming: Obtain ADC at least 10 minutes before entering Bangladesh ADIZ / Dhaka FIR
cpdlc.notes: Routes P646, N895, M770, L524, W112 exempt from ADC unless deviating toward Bangladesh landmass.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: SSR Mode A/C/S surveillance.

slop.offsetRule: Do not deviate toward landmass without ADC number

ssr.transponderFailureRule: If unable to contact ATS, contact nearest Air Defense Unit on 6826 kHz / 500 kHz prior to entering ADIZ.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 15 minutes prior to entry into Colombo FIR (departures: 5 mins prior to leaving TMA)
cpdlc.notes: From Jeppesen Middle East p.67: Logon to VCCF 15 mins prior to entry; obtain ADC number from ACC 15 mins prior to ADIZ entry.

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: From Jeppesen Middle East p.65: ADS-B mandated within 330 NM of 070003N/0804618E from FL290 to FL460 for aircraft >5700kg or >250kt TAS.

slop.offsetRule: 0.1 NM increments up to 2.0 NM right in oceanic airspace outside ADIZ

ssr.transponderFailureRule: Standard ICAO SSR procedures; strict ADIZ compliance required.

cpdlc.logonTiming: 10 to 15 minutes prior to entering Jeddah/Riyadh CTA at FL290+
cpdlc.notes: From Jeppesen Middle East p.20 & p.67: CPDLC available FL290+ (OEJN for Jeddah ACC, OERK for Riyadh ACC).

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: From Jeppesen Middle East p.64: All aircraft operating in Jeddah FIR classes A, B, C, D, or E must be equipped with ADS-B Out.

slop.offsetRule: Continental radar airspace

ssr.transponderFailureRule: From Jeppesen Middle East p.59: Squawk 7000 prior to entering Jeddah FIR as an uncontrolled flight; squawk 1100 prior to departure when code not yet allocated.

cpdlc.logonTiming: Prior to pushback (DCL) or 15 mins prior to KUSA boundary
cpdlc.notes: US Domestic Data Comm: single logon 'KUSA' handles all domestic ARTCC transfers (KZDV -> KZLA).

pbnAdsB.adsBNote: 1090ES ADS-B Out mandatory in Class A, B, C and above 10,000 ft MSL (14 CFR 91.225).

slop.offsetRule: Domestic US radar airspace — no SLOP

ssr.transponderFailureRule: 14 CFR 91.215: ATC authorization required to continue in Class A airspace if transponder fails.
